summary: Headless Content API v1 serves published posts, pages, and public tags behind a site-level API key.
detailed_changes: Added /api/content/v1 routes for posts, pages, and tags with key auth (X-Newsroom-Content-Key or Authorization: Newsroom-Key).
Only published content is exposed; body HTML is returned only for visibility=public, with members/paid marked gated.
Documented versioning, pagination, and rate limits in docs/api.md.
affected_areas: User groups affected: headless/API consumers; staff (ops configuring NEWSROOM_CONTENT_API_KEY)
Public impact: none on the website UI; new authenticated API surface
Internal impact: rate-limited Content API; unconfigured key returns 503
